tabs.overview: The production casing takes the frac pressure, so its burst rating sets the treating pressure ceiling with the tree; sour wells use restricted-yield grades; premium connections for gas tightness and high torque.
tabs.engineering: Per API Spec 5CT; design factors per the operator standard.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki fracturing fluids and additives (S50), propping agents (S51), API RP 19C (S52), API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), field practice (S9).

name: Casing and tubing grades and connections
function: The steel grades (API 5CT: J55, L80, N80, P110 and others) and connections (API round, buttress, premium) chosen for burst, collapse, tension, and sour service.

standards.paraphrase: Casing and tubing grades, dimensions, and testing.
